question: What is the meaning of biocompatibility in relation to biological property?
description: Biocompatibility refers to the ability of a material to perform its desired function without eliciting any undesirable local or systemic effects in a biological system. It is a measure of how well a material or substance interacts with living tissue, ensuring safety and compatibility in medical applications.
